q1.explanationZh: desert 读 /ˈdezət/ 时是名词“沙漠”，读 /dɪˈzɜːt/ 时是动词“抛弃”；注意与 dessert“甜点”区分。

q2.explanationZh: deserve 及物动词“应得；值得”，deserve sth./deserve to do sth.。

q3.explanationZh: design 动词“设计”，名词“图案；设计”，注意不发音的 g。

q4.explanationZh: desire 动词、名词同形，“渴望；愿望”，desire sb. to do“希望某人做”。

q6.explanationZh: desktop = desk + top，“桌面；台式（电脑）”。

q7.explanationZh: despair 名词、动词同形“绝望”，to the despair of sb.“令某人绝望的是”。

q8.explanationZh: desperate 形容词“不顾一切的；绝望的”，副词 desperately。

q9.explanationZh: despite 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不加 of；相当于 in spite of。

q10.explanationZh: dessert“甜点”有两个 s，desert“沙漠”只有一个 s。

q11.explanationZh: destination 名词“目的地”，travel destination“旅游目的地”。

q12.explanationZh: destroy 及物动词“破坏；毁灭”，名词是 destruction。

q13.explanationZh: destroy 的名词形式 destruction“破坏；毁灭”，注意拼写 -struction。

q14.explanationZh: detail 名词“细节”，动词“详述”，in detail“详细地”。

q15.explanationZh: detect 及物动词“察觉；侦查出”，加 -ive 构成 detective“侦探”。

q16.explanationZh: detective 作形容词“侦探的”，作名词“侦探”，detective story“侦探小说”。

q17.explanationZh: determine 去 e 加 -ation 构成名词 determination“决心”。

q18.explanationZh: determine“决定；下决心”，be determined to do sth.“决心做某事”。

q19.explanationZh: develop 既可及物也可不及物，“发展；开发；成长”，词尾没有 e。

q20.explanationZh: develop 加 -ment 构成名词 development“发展”。

q21.explanationZh: device 是名词“装置”，注意与动词 devise“设计；发明”区分。

q22.explanationZh: devote 及物动词“奉献”，devote oneself to doing sth.，to 是介词。

q23.explanationZh: diagnose 及物动词“诊断”，be diagnosed as/with“被诊断为”。

q24.explanationZh: diagram 名词“示意图；图表”，dia- + gram（图）。

q25.explanationZh: dial 作动词“拨（电话号码）”，作名词“表盘；钟面”。

q26.explanationZh: dialect 名词“方言”，Shanghai dialect“上海话”。

q27.explanationZh: dialogue 是英式拼写，dialog 是美式拼写，两种都对。

q28.explanationZh: diamond 名词“钻石”，a diamond ring“钻石戒指”。

q29.explanationZh: diary“日记”，keep a diary“记日记”；注意与 dairy“乳制品”区分。

q30.explanationZh: dictate“口授”加 -ion（去 e）构成名词 dictation“听写”。

q31.explanationZh: dictionary“词典”，look up a word in the dictionary“查词典”。

q32.explanationZh: die“死”，现在分词 dying，形容词 dead，名词 death。

q33.explanationZh: diet 名词“日常饮食”，on a diet“节食”。

q34.explanationZh: deserve well of“应受到……奖赏”，deserve ill of“应受到……处罚”。

q35.explanationZh: design 作名词“图案；设计图”，a design for sth.“……的图样”。

q36.explanationZh: desire 后直接接宾语，desire sth.“渴望……”。

q37.explanationZh: desire sb. to do“希望某人做……”，后接带不定式的复合宾语。

q38.explanationZh: devote oneself to“献身于”，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q39.explanationZh: in detail“详细地”，detail 用单数，不加冠词。

q40.explanationZh: be determined to do sth.“决心做某事”，强调决心已下的状态。

accept: determine sb. to do sth./determine sb. against sth.
determine sb. to do sth,/determine sb. against sth.

q41.explanationZh: determine sb. to do sth.“使某人决定做某事”，determine sb. against sth.“使某人决定不做某事”。书末答案原印 determine sb. to do sth,（sth 后误印逗号），经人工复核更正为 sth.（GitHub #136）；原印标点变体仍接受。

q42.explanationZh: a device for doing sth.“做某事的装置”，for 后接动名词。

q43.explanationZh: on a diet“节食”，如 be/go on a diet“在节食/开始节食”。

q44.explanationZh: die 后接同源名词 death，die a ... death“以……方式死去”。

q45.explanationZh: die out“消失；灭绝”，多指物种、风俗等完全消失。

q46.explanationZh: die down“逐渐消失；变弱”，如风、火、声音渐渐平息。

q47.explanationZh: die of 多指因疾病、饥饿、年老等内部原因死亡。

q48.explanationZh: die from 多指因受伤、事故等外部原因死亡。

q49.explanationZh: die out“消失”；are 后用现在进行时，die 的现在分词是 dying（ie 变 y 加 -ing）。

q50.explanationZh: “甜点”是 dessert；that combine 用复数动词，所以用复数 desserts。

q51.explanationZh: 讨论计划的“细节”，the details of sth.，用复数 details。

q52.explanationZh: 汽车“被设计”，现在完成时被动语态 has been designed。

q53.explanationZh: 古建筑“被破坏”，一般过去时被动语态 were destroyed。

q54.explanationZh: my 后面要用名词，determination to do sth.“做某事的决心”。

q55.explanationZh: the ... of 结构中要用名词，destroy 的名词是 destruction。

q56.explanationZh: to the despair of sb.“令某人绝望的是”，despair 作不可数名词。

q57.explanationZh: devote oneself to doing sth.“致力于做某事”；since 引导时间状语，用现在完成时 has devoted。

q58.explanationZh: be determined to do sth.“决心做某事”，was 后用形容词 determined。

q59.sampleAnswer: Despite the fact that live-streaming marketing is very popular, problems brought about by it such as fake and inferior products and after-sales services cannot be neglected.
references: Despite the fact that live-streaming marketing is very popular, problems brought about by it such as fake and inferior products and after-sales services cannot be neglected.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “虽然”用 despite the fact that...（despite 是介词，后接 the fact that 从句）；“带来”= bring about；“不容小觑”= cannot be neglected。

q60.sampleAnswer: The more desperate a person is for fame and wealth, the less likely he will do things in a practical manner.
references: The more desperate a person is for fame and wealth, the less likely he will do things in a practical manner.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “越……就越……”= the more..., the less...；“渴望名利”= be desperate for fame and wealth；“脚踏实地”= in a practical manner。

q61.sampleAnswer: Whoever takes action to realize his dream deserves our respect.
references: Whoever takes action to realize his dream deserves our respect.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “任何……的人”用 whoever 引导主语从句，谓语用单数 deserves；“应该受到尊敬”= deserve respect；“付诸行动”= take action。

q62.sampleAnswer: Those species inadaptable to changing conditions may die out.
references: Those species inadaptable to changing conditions may die out.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “灭绝”= die out；“不能适应……的”= inadaptable to，作后置定语；“不断变化的环境”= changing conditions。

q63.sampleAnswer: People have become accustomed to researching travel destinations via social media videos, which provide practical insights into their independent travel and help them feel more confident about exploring unfamiliar places.
references: People have become accustomed to researching travel destinations via social media videos, which provide practical insights into their independent travel and help them feel more confident about exploring unfamiliar places.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “习惯了做某事”= become accustomed to doing sth.（to 是介词）；“目的地”= destinations；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰视频。

q64.sampleAnswer: Despite his poor family, the boy is ambitious and dreams of getting the Nobel Prize one day.
references: Despite his poor family, the boy is ambitious and dreams of getting the Nobel Prize one day.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “尽管”= despite，后接名词短语 his poor family，不能再用 but；“志存高远”= be ambitious；“梦想做某事”= dream of doing sth.。

q65.sampleAnswer: It happens that a distant relative of the reporter knows the intricate details of rural development inside out.
references: It happens that a distant relative of the reporter knows the intricate details of rural development inside out.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “巧的是”= It happens that...；“丝丝脉络”= the intricate details；“了如指掌”= know... inside out。

q66.sampleAnswer: As children develop, some of the most important things they learn have to do with their sense of self.
references: As children develop, some of the most important things they learn have to do with their sense of self.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “在成长过程中”= as children develop，develop 作不及物动词“成长”；“与……有关”= have to do with；“自我意识”= sense of self。

q67.sampleAnswer: There are no difficulties that cannot be overcome as long as both parties are determined to reach an agreement.
references: There are no difficulties that cannot be overcome as long as both parties are determined to reach an agreement.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “决心做某事”= be determined to do sth.；“只要”= as long as；“达成协议”= reach an agreement。

q68.sampleAnswer: People who are aware of the importance of health are paying more and more attention to their diets.
references: People who are aware of the importance of health are paying more and more attention to their diets.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “饮食”= diet；“意识到”= be aware of；“越来越关注”= pay more and more attention to；who 引导定语从句修饰 people。
